exact_blockers.requirement: Create a machine-readable source manifest for LJ Speech LJ001-0001 with the exact transcript, geometry, byte count, SHA-256, licence and rights-record digest; only a research README prose table exists.

Create a machine-readable accent manifest for the ABA, RRBI and HJK L2-ARCTIC clips with speaker, clip identifier, L1 group, source locator, byte count, SHA-256, duration and transcript; three local copies exist without any manifest.
Record the p360 target-reference speaker, upstream RT-VC demo source, dataset terms and written permission; the pinned README states that dataset/licence provenance is not yet confirmed.
Obtain per-speaker consent for LJ001, p360, ABA, RRBI and HJK covering conversion, accent modification, output publication, retention and redistribution; no consent record exists.

Record the LJ Speech, L2-ARCTIC and TokAN-sample terms, attribution, noncommercial boundary and redistribution or publication grant; the pinned notes report CC BY-NC 4.0 for L2-ARCTIC and no visible TokAN licence file.
Freeze a rights-cleared cohort with source/target/accent roles, paired and unpaired items, held-out speakers or items, negative and quiet controls and the exact permitted use.

Pin the scorer and its revision, manual transcripts and accent ground truth, aggregation, failed-item policy, evidence-class separation and one invalid plus one valid bundle path; only a synthetic structural control exists.
Record an approved opt-in adapter decision, independent exact-head review, default policy and release or benchmark approval; no adapter, registration or release claim exists.

source_reported_context.accent_classifier_status: the six-class accent classifier is a directional proxy trained mainly on native-speaker Common Voice; it is not L2-ARCTIC ground truth and does not include Korean-accented English
source_reported_context.accent_status: three clips from the TokAN demo sample set, reported to use L2-ARCTIC speakers ABA, RRBI and HJK; the official corpus terms are reported as CC BY-NC 4.0 and the three clips are a small smoke slice
source_reported_context.label: source_reported_not_measured_here
source_reported_context.licence_status: the TokAN repository is reported to have no visible licence file; resolve provenance and licensing before product use
source_reported_context.ljspeech_status: local clean-real-voice reference documented as LJ Speech 1.1 LJ001-0001; the dataset page is reported to describe the recordings as public domain
source_reported_context.ljspeech_transcript: Printing, in the only sense with which we are at present concerned, differs from most if not from all the arts and crafts represented in the Exhibition.
source_reported_context.notes: The pinned research notes retain local run results for several models.  None of those results is reproduced, rescored or promoted here.  No source-reported value qualifies this evidence task.
source_reported_context.target_reference_status: RT-VC upstream demo 3_to_p360/target.flac; dataset and licence provenance are explicitly not yet confirmed
